components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: 550 14px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--accent, #1f8a4c); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--accent, #1f8a4c); border-radius: 7px; padding: 7px 12px; line-height: 20px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #1f8a4c) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary actions such as cancel or discard.
components.css: .ds-btn { font: 14px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--panel, #fff); color: var(--ink, #1c1c1a); border: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e2de); border-radius: 7px; padding: 7px 12px; line-height: 20px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: var(--muted, #6b6b66); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #1f8a4c) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field in dialogs and cards (Well).
components.css: .ds-input { font: 14px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #1c1c1a); background: var(--field, #f6f6f4); border: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e2de); border-radius: 7px; padding: 7px 10px; line-height: 20px; width: 240px; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #1f8a4c) 40%, transparent); border-color: var(--accent, #1f8a4c); }

components.name: Text Tabs
components.description: Main navigation on the header's bottom seam, and tabs inside a card; the active tab is ink with a 2 px underline that covers the seam.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 22px; box-shadow: inset 0 -1px var(--line, #e3e2de); overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; } .ds-tab { font: 14px/1.45 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; background: none; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 0 10px; color: var(--muted, #6b6b66); white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--ink, #1c1c1a); } .ds-tab.active { color: var(--ink, #1c1c1a); border-bottom-color: var(--ink, #1c1c1a); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #1f8a4c) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chips
components.html: Hub: 18 tools 2 tools disabled used 3×
components.css: .ds-chip { font: 11.5px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; background: var(--chip, #efeeea); color: var(--muted, #6b6b66); padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 99px; } .ds-ok { color: var(--ok, #1f8a4c); } .ds-warn { color: var(--warn, #b26a00); }

components.name: Listbox
components.description: Replaces native selects; check mark on the right, keyboard ↑/↓/Enter/Esc.

components.css: .ds-lb { font: 14px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; display: inline-grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-lb-trigger { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 200px; justify-content: space-between; font: inherit; color: var(--ink, #1c1c1a); background: var(--panel, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e2de); border-radius: 7px; padding: 7px 10px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-lb-trigger svg { color: var(--muted, #6b6b66); } .ds-lb-pop { background: var(--panel, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e2de); border-radius: 9px; padding: 4px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / .18); width: 240px; } .ds-lb-opt { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--ink, #1c1c1a); cursor: pointer; } .ds-lb-opt:hover, .ds-hi { background: var(--chip, #efeeea); } .ds-lb-opt svg { color: var(--ink, #1c1c1a); }

components.name: FieldGroup
components.description: Related controls with a shared border and a straight seam.
components.css: .ds-fg { display: inline-flex; font: 14px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e2de); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--panel, #fff); } .ds-fg:hover { border-color: var(--muted, #6b6b66); } .ds-fg:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent, #1f8a4c); outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #1f8a4c) 40%, transparent); } .ds-fg button { font: inherit; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-fg-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; color: var(--muted, #6b6b66); border-radius: 6px 0 0 6px; } .ds-fg-part { padding: 7px 10px; color: var(--ink, #1c1c1a); border-left: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e2de) !important; border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0; } .ds-fg button:hover { background: var(--chip, #efeeea); color: var(--ink, #1c1c1a); }

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Custom checkbox in Well and Switch Green.
components.css: .ds-check { display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; font: 13.5px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #1c1c1a); } .ds-check input { appearance: none; display: grid; place-content: center; width: 16px; height: 16px; margin: 0; border: 1px solid var(--muted, #6b6b66); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--field, #f6f6f4); cursor: pointer; } .ds-check input::before { content: ''; width: 4px; height: 8px; margin-top: -2px; border: solid var(--on-accent, #fff); border-width: 0 2px 2px 0; transform: rotate(45deg) scale(0); transition: transform .12s ease-out; } .ds-check input:checked { background: var(--accent, #1f8a4c); border-color: var(--accent, #1f8a4c); } .ds-check input:checked::before { transform: rotate(45deg) scale(1); }

narrative.overview:
A calm control center you open in passing and understand in seconds. The surface is restrained and warm gray, content sits in clear lists, and color almost always carries meaning: green means “running” or “primary action”, orange “deviating”, red “error”. Everything else lives behind a ⋯ menu or a list, not out on the surface.

The density is that of a tool, not a marketing page: 14 px base type, technical values in monospace, status as small chips. Light and dark schemes are equal and follow the system setting; the dark scheme is the everyday one, next to terminal and editor.

There are no native operating-system controls. Selects, checkboxes and menus are custom components so they look and behave the same in both schemes.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (green) with meaning, otherwise neutral, slightly warm grays
Flat: depth through surface tones, shadows only on floating elements
Related controls as a FieldGroup with a shared border
Secondary actions behind ⋯ menus, choices through custom listboxes
System font for text, monospace for commands, URLs, names and chips

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Rule
rules.body: Green, orange and red only appear when they denote a state or the primary action. There is no decorative color.

rules.name: The Twin Scheme Rule
rules.body: Every color exists as a light and dark pair (`-dark`); new colors are always added as tokens on `:root` for both schemes, never directly on an element.

rules.name: The Copyable Is Mono Rule
rules.body: Anything that belongs in a configuration, a terminal or a URL bar is set in monospace; descriptions never are.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow means “floats above the content and goes away again”. Cards, lists and fields get none.

rules.name: The One Height Rule
rules.body: Fields, listbox triggers and buttons share one height (36 px: 20 px line height, 7 px padding, 1 px border) so they line up in every row. Fields set their own 14 px type instead of inheriting the smaller label size.

rules.name: The Shared Edge Rule
rules.body: In a FieldGroup only the outer corners are rounded (7 px outside, 6 px inside); inside, a straight 1 px seam separates the parts. No element overlaps another with a negative margin.

dos: Do build every choice as a custom listbox; check mark on the right, keyboard as above.
Do show related controls as a FieldGroup with a shared border.
Do put secondary and destructive actions into a ⋯ menu; “Delete” last, red, after a divider.
Do add new colors as a token pair on `:root`, light and dark.
Do show fields in dialogs and cards in the Well (`field`) so they stand out.
Do check chart colors with the dataviz validator for both schemes before using them.
Do keep every interface string in the translation dictionary in German and English.
donts: Don't leave native `<select>`, checkboxes or browser focus rings visible.
Don't use green, orange or red decoratively.
Don't give cards, lists or fields a shadow.
Don't let elements of a group overlap with negative margins; the divider belongs to one element.
Don't write comments into the HTML; the file is shipped to the browser.
